To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the vascular plexus of peritumour tissue becomes incorporated into the growing melanoma, and this incorporation is the major source of vascularization.
the peritumor vascular plexus is the source of vascularization of human and murine malignant melanoma and the vascular density of the tumour center is the only prognostic indicator of the disease.
the peritumorally located vascular plexus is continuously incorporated into the growing melanoma and that the pericytes are present in the microvessels of both human and mouse melanoma.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the vascular development of human malignant melanomas and an appropriate mouse melanoma model.
the vascularization of cutaneous malignant melanomas (hMM) of the skin.
the development of a new method for the development of a novel vascularization of cutaneous malignant melanoma.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the vascularization of cutaneous hMM involves vessel co‐optation of the peritumorally present vascular plexus, which is continuously incorporated into the growing melanoma.
the vascularization of cutaneous hMM is a complex process, involving vessel co‐option, and the peritumoral vascular plexus is a source of the vascular network of the growing tumour.

the vascular network in the peritumor tissue of human and murine malignant melanomas is continuously being incorporated by the tumour, which in turn is the main factor in the development of metastases.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pericytes play a major role in the formation and maturation of microvessela and in the maintenance of the integrity of the vessel wall.
the vascular plexus of the tumour bed is the source of vessels that vascularize the melanoma, and that the vessels in the peritumor region of hMM are more mature than those in the tumour core.
pericyte coverage was complete in all investigated areas and the peritumoral vascular plexus is incorporated into the growing tumor mass.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the peritumor vasculature of melanoma is a dynamic structure that is incorporated into the tumor mass and becomes part of the tumor vasculature.
the peritumor vascular plexus is continuously incorporated into the tumour mass and that the pericytes cover endothelial cells of vessels at all tumour sites.

the peritumor vascular plexus of hMM is incorporated into the growing tumor, and the fate of ECs in the periphery of the tumor mass is different than that of ECs located at the center of the tumor mass.
